verdict.rationale: Docs mention an onboarding flow that suggests starter Tasks based on user input (docs-2/46) and a single guided wizard for connecting a local Agent (docs-4/26), which shows some first-run guidance rather than raw config editing. However, there is no evidence of a wizard specifically covering model credentials setup, channel/connector configuration, and default settings in one guided flow — self-hosting docs still reference Docker Compose deployment and manual SSO/config docs (docs-8, docs-37) rather than an all-in-one wizard. missing for 10: explicit onboarding wizard for API keys/model credentials, no evidence of a 'channels' setup step, no evidence defaults are configured via wizard rather than settings pages.
